explanation: Partition the current range into values greater than, equal to and less than a pivot. Keep only the partition containing the zero-based rank k−1 in descending order. Three-way partitioning handles repeated values efficiently and rearranges the input.
timeComplexity: O(n) average time; O(n^2) worst-case time for unfavorable pivots.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
